Misalignment.strongest_genuine_evidence_mechanisms: Relative column anchor break (mean: 116.7px), residual translation-corrected drift (median: 117.1px), and low directional coherence (0.11).
Misalignment.major_false_positive_sources: Legitimate horizontal reflow where entire form shifts right (resolved by reflow ratio).

Overlapping.strongest_genuine_evidence_mechanisms: Direct non-zero bounding box intersection area (mean: 11,847px²), multi-axis intrusion (mean: 120.2px H, 35.7px V), and sibling gap collapse (94.7%).
Overlapping.major_false_positive_sources: Loose OCR bounding boxes overlapping background container card frames.
Overlapping.major_ambiguity_sources: 0px boundary-to-boundary touching contact without negative pixel penetration.

Truncation.strongest_genuine_evidence_mechanisms: Verified localized ellipsis ('...', 60.0% of cases), measured text-to-container overflow, and pixel glyph edge cuts.
evidence_features_missing: Internal control drawing bounds for custom OwnerDraw Win32 widgets
Truncation.major_false_positive_sources: Unconstrained floating labels expanding without bounding containers.
Truncation.major_ambiguity_sources: Text expanding within auto-expanding containers (handled by accommodation tracking).

Untranslation.strongest_genuine_evidence_mechanisms: Preserved user-facing English words (mean: 12.08 words vs 5.59 in non-untrans), high Latin character ratio, and dictionary term retention.
evidence_features_missing: Contextual semantic dictionary for domain-specific engineering jargon
Untranslation.major_false_positive_sources: Universal technical acronyms (DWG, CAD, BIM, OK, Cancel, X/Y/Z) and sample file paths.
Untranslation.major_ambiguity_sources: Transliterated brand names or short 2-3 letter abbreviations.

Repeated hotkey.strongest_genuine_evidence_mechanisms: VISUALLY UNSUPPORTED via plain OCR. Mnemonics are rendered as Win32 font underlines or handled in resource binary (.rc) tables.
Repeated hotkey.major_false_positive_sources: OCR reading trademark (R) or punctuation as parenthesized accelerator.
Repeated hotkey.major_ambiguity_sources: Total invisibility of native Alt-key underlines to standard OCR.
